dialogues.jp: 「あ〜、どうしようかな今日は……」
dialogues.en: 'Ahh~, what to do for today..."
dialogues.text: 'Ahh~, what to do for today..."

dialogues.jp:
トイレに行っていたせいで、昼のバトルに乗り
遅れた。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to the call of nature, the noontime battle for bread
is almost certainly lost by now.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to the call of nature, the noontime battle for bread
is almost certainly lost by now.

dialogues.jp:
「今から購買行っても、ろくなの置いてないだ
　ろうし」
dialogues.en:
"If I went now, everything edible would be sold out
already."
dialogues.text:
"If I went now, everything edible would be sold out
already."

dialogues.jp: 「食堂で食うか……って、あれはことりか？」
dialogues.en: "I guess I'd eat at the cafeteria... hm, isn't that Kotori?
dialogues.text: "I guess I'd eat at the cafeteria... hm, isn't that Kotori?

dialogues.jp:
何やら、胸にいっぱいに物を抱えた女の子が校
門の方から歩いてきた。今にもこぼれそうで、
見ていて危なっかしい。
dialogues.en:
A girl, carrying a bagful of something to her chest, was
walking in through the school entrance. Her view was
probably obscured.
dialogues.text:
A girl, carrying a bagful of something to her chest, was
walking in through the school entrance. Her view was
probably obscured.

dialogues.jp: 知らない奴なら気にならなかったんだが……。
dialogues.en:
I bet she doesn't even notice how dangerous it is to do that
alone...
dialogues.text:
I bet she doesn't even notice how dangerous it is to do that
alone...

dialogues.jp: 「おい、ことり」
dialogues.en: "Oy, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Oy, Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君。こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "Good afternoon, Asakura-kun!"
dialogues.text: "Good afternoon, Asakura-kun!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「おう……って、のんびり挨拶してる感じじゃ
　ないだろ。手伝おうか？」
dialogues.en: "Goo... buh, that's not what I want to say. Need some help?"
dialogues.text: "Goo... buh, that's not what I want to say. Need some help?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい。お願い出来ますか」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, could you?"
dialogues.text: "Sorry, could you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「おやすいご用」
dialogues.en: "At your service."
dialogues.text: "At your service."

dialogues.jp:
積み木崩しのように、ひょいひょいと物を取っ
ていく。パンやらジュースやらだ。
dialogues.en:
I took the bag off her hands. Inside was several packets of
juice and bread.
dialogues.text:
I took the bag off her hands. Inside was several packets of
juice and bread.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう。おかげで、楽になりました」
dialogues.en: "THanks for your help."
dialogues.text: "THanks for your help."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「何だよことり。相撲取りにでもなるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Wow, Kotori. Are you aspiring to be a sumo wrestler?"
dialogues.text: "Wow, Kotori. Are you aspiring to be a sumo wrestler?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なれませんよ。女の子なんだから」
dialogues.en: "Of course not, I'm a girl after all."
dialogues.text: "Of course not, I'm a girl after all."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いや、女相撲とか」
dialogues.en: "I meant a girl wrestler."
dialogues.text: "I meant a girl wrestler."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「な、何ですか、それは」
dialogues.en: "W, what's that supposed to mean..."
dialogues.text: "W, what's that supposed to mean..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いや、知らないならいいんだけど」
dialogues.en: "Well, never mind, it's better if you don't know."
dialogues.text: "Well, never mind, it's better if you don't know."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「も、もう、変な事言わないでくださいよね」
dialogues.en: "...G, geez, please don't talk about weird things..."
dialogues.text: "...G, geez, please don't talk about weird things..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　知ってるの？　女相撲」
dialogues.en: "Hm? You know about female wrestling?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? You know about female wrestling?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「知らないですっ」
dialogues.en: "No I don't!"
dialogues.text: "No I don't!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そうか」
dialogues.en: "Uh, okay."
dialogues.text: "Uh, okay."

dialogues.jp: よく分からん会話の間だな……。
dialogues.en: I'm not understanding this conversation much...
dialogues.text: I'm not understanding this conversation much...

dialogues.jp:
「で、何でこんなに買い込んでんの？　もしや、
　パシリ？」
dialogues.en:
"Then why are you carrying so much food at a time? Is
someone taking advantage of you or something?"
dialogues.text:
"Then why are you carrying so much food at a time? Is
someone taking advantage of you or something?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そういうんじゃないですよ……」
dialogues.en: "That isn't exactly it..."
dialogues.text: "That isn't exactly it..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「じゃんけんで負けたんで、私が友達の分も買っ
　てくる事にしたんです」
dialogues.en:
"My friends and I had a quick round of Rock-Paper-Scissors
to decide who would go get lunch for everyone... and I
lost."
dialogues.text:
"My friends and I had a quick round of Rock-Paper-Scissors
to decide who would go get lunch for everyone... and I
lost."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ならいいんだけどな」
dialogues.en: "Oh, isn't as bad as I thought then."
dialogues.text: "Oh, isn't as bad as I thought then."

dialogues.jp:
ことりは男子に人気があるし、そこら辺、女子
には｛ねた／妬｝まれているかと思ったのだ。
dialogues.en:
Although Kotori's really popular among the boys, she's has
noticably worse of a reputation among girls, who generally
seem to be envious of her.
dialogues.text:
Although Kotori's really popular among the boys, she's has
noticably worse of a reputation among girls, who generally
seem to be envious of her.

dialogues.jp:
女の子同士って、割とそういうのありそうな気
がする……偏見か？
dialogues.en:
They tend to give her a wide berth... nothing but prejudice,
really...
dialogues.text:
They tend to give her a wide berth... nothing but prejudice,
really...

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫ですよ」
dialogues.en: "It's alright."
dialogues.text: "It's alright."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　何が？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What is?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What is?"

dialogues.jp:
打ち明け話でもするように、ことりは顔を近づ
けてきた。
dialogues.en:
As if telling me a secret, her face started getting closer
to mine.
dialogues.text:
As if telling me a secret, her face started getting closer
to mine.

dialogues.jp: ふわぁ……。
dialogues.en: Whoa...
dialogues.text: Whoa...

dialogues.jp: 甘い匂いが、した。
dialogues.en: A sweet smell whistled through my nose.
dialogues.text: A sweet smell whistled through my nose.

dialogues.jp: 髪の匂い？　それとも……。
dialogues.en: Is that her hair? Or...
dialogues.text: Is that her hair? Or...

dialogues.jp: 少しだけ、どきりとした。
dialogues.en: her actions startled me for a few moments.
dialogues.text: her actions startled me for a few moments.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こう見えても、私、友達は多いんですから」
dialogues.en: "As you can see, I have plenty of friends..."
dialogues.text: "As you can see, I have plenty of friends..."

dialogues.jp:
顔が離れていく。同時に、甘い匂いもしなくなっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Her face pulled back from mine again, and at the same time,
the sweet scent went away.
dialogues.text:
Her face pulled back from mine again, and at the same time,
the sweet scent went away.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、肩をすくめた。
dialogues.en: I shrugged my shoulders slightly.
dialogues.text: I shrugged my shoulders slightly.

dialogues.jp:
「だろうな。この食べ物の量だったら。フォア
　グラみたいな奴が友達でもない限り」
dialogues.en: "I suppose, with how much you have in this bag..."
dialogues.text: "I suppose, with how much you have in this bag..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「何かおまけしてもらっちゃったんですよ。た
　くさん買ったからって」
dialogues.en: "There'd probably be some extra, I did buy a lot."
dialogues.text: "There'd probably be some extra, I did buy a lot."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だから、頼まれてないのも入ってるんですよ
　ね」
dialogues.en:
"So some of them will probably just get kept for a snack
afterwards."
dialogues.text:
"So some of them will probably just get kept for a snack
afterwards."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ほー。それはそれは｛うらや／羨｝ましいこって」
dialogues.en: "Heh, I'm green with envy."
dialogues.text: "Heh, I'm green with envy."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いります？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want some?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want some?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　マジ？」
dialogues.en: "Eh, seriously?"
dialogues.text: "Eh, seriously?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「マジです」
dialogues.en: "Seriously."
dialogues.text: "Seriously."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「くれくれ」
dialogues.en: "Of course!"
dialogues.text: "Of course!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いいですよ。手伝ってもらったお礼です」
dialogues.en: "It'd be fine then. Treat it as thanks for your help."
dialogues.text: "It'd be fine then. Treat it as thanks for your help."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「助かった。これで、食堂に行かなくて済む」
dialogues.en: "Whew, thanks. I won't have to go to the cafeteria now."
dialogues.text: "Whew, thanks. I won't have to go to the cafeteria now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……食堂の、嫌いなんですか？」
dialogues.en: "...You don't like the cafeteria?"
dialogues.text: "...You don't like the cafeteria?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「味じゃない。そこまで行くのがかったるいん
　だ」
dialogues.en:
"The food there's not tasty at all. I stay away from it if
at all possible."
dialogues.text:
"The food there's not tasty at all. I stay away from it if
at all possible."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「めんどくさがり屋さんなんですね」
dialogues.en: "You'd sadden those poor hardworking storeowners there."
dialogues.text: "You'd sadden those poor hardworking storeowners there."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「意外とな」
dialogues.en: "Out of the point."
dialogues.text: "Out of the point."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「意外って事もありませんけど」
dialogues.en: "No it isn't."
dialogues.text: "No it isn't."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あっと、ストップです」
dialogues.en: "Oops, stop here!"
dialogues.text: "Oops, stop here!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: ぴたっと足を止める。
dialogues.en: I stopped dead in my tracks.
dialogues.text: I stopped dead in my tracks.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「こっちこっち」
dialogues.en: "Over here."
dialogues.text: "Over here."

dialogues.jp: とてとてと小走りにどこかへ向かう。
dialogues.en: Kotori walked a bit to the side.
dialogues.text: Kotori walked a bit to the side.

dialogues.jp: 「どうかした？」
dialogues.en: "What's up?"
dialogues.text: "What's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉君は、ここで待っててもらえますか。す
　ぐに戻りますから」
dialogues.en: "Please just wait here for a second. I'd be right back!"
dialogues.text: "Please just wait here for a second. I'd be right back!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、いいけど」
dialogues.en: "Uhh, okay."
dialogues.text: "Uhh, okay."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんだ……？」
dialogues.en: "What's going on?..."
dialogues.text: "What's going on?..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「お待たせです。荷物、渡してくれますか」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry for making you wait. I just finished distributing the
food."
dialogues.text:
"Sorry for making you wait. I just finished distributing the
food."

dialogues.jp: 戻ってきたことりは、手ぶらだった。
dialogues.en: The returning Kotori held up her hand teasingly in apology.
dialogues.text: The returning Kotori held up her hand teasingly in apology.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「男子に手伝ってもらったなんて知れたら、冷
　やかされちゃうと思うんですよね」
dialogues.en:
"Things might have gotten a bit weird if they knew that a
guy was helping me."
dialogues.text:
"Things might have gotten a bit weird if they knew that a
guy was helping me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なるほどな」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I see."
dialogues.text: "Ah, I see."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、これと、これは、朝倉君の分です」
dialogues.en: "Ah, and this is your share."
dialogues.text: "Ah, and this is your share."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、俺の元に、二つのパンを残してく
れた。
dialogues.en: She gave me two packets of bread.
dialogues.text: She gave me two packets of bread.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それでは、バイバイです。ありがとさんでし
　た」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, thank you so much. Bye bye!"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, thank you so much. Bye bye!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん、じゃあね」
dialogues.en: "Right, later."
dialogues.text: "Right, later."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「よっしゃ、兵糧も確保したし、陣地に戻るか」
dialogues.en: "Alright! Rations secured, time to head back to camp."
dialogues.text: "Alright! Rations secured, time to head back to camp."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「って、これ、見たこともねえパンだな……美
　味いのか？」
dialogues.en:
"...Then again, I've never tried this flavour of bread
before... wonder if it's good?"
dialogues.text:
"...Then again, I've never tried this flavour of bread
before... wonder if it's good?"

dialogues.jp:
袋には、“真っ白なジャムパン”と書かれてあ
る。
dialogues.en: "Pure White Jam Bread" was written on the bag.
dialogues.text: "Pure White Jam Bread" was written on the bag.

dialogues.jp:
また、注意書きとして、衣服に付けたり、目に
入らないようご注意を、なんて文章が。
dialogues.en:
It continued on cautioning not to let clothes come in
contact with it, or to stare at it for long periods of time.
dialogues.text:
It continued on cautioning not to let clothes come in
contact with it, or to stare at it for long periods of time.

dialogues.jp: 「さらには、子どもの手の届かない所に、か…」
dialogues.en:
"Doesn't look like it'd be safe for kids, or anyone, to
eat..."
dialogues.text:
"Doesn't look like it'd be safe for kids, or anyone, to
eat..."

dialogues.jp: 「単なる、廃品処理？」
dialogues.en: "Straight to the garbage bin, perhaps?"
dialogues.text: "Straight to the garbage bin, perhaps?"

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりはパシリ？◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori the Slave?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori the Slave?◆

dialogues.jp:
パシリのように荷物を運んでいることりを手伝
うと、お礼にと、パンをもらってしまった。
dialogues.en:
Helping out Kotori in a slave-like circumstance, I was
rewarded with a few packets of bread for my troubles.
dialogues.text:
Helping out Kotori in a slave-like circumstance, I was
rewarded with a few packets of bread for my troubles.

dialogues.jp:
嬉しいのだが……何だか、良く分からないパン
だな。
dialogues.en:
It felt good... but the bread certainly didn't look as good
as I felt.
dialogues.text:
It felt good... but the bread certainly didn't look as good
as I felt.
